nodes.text: If you access Claude through an employer's Teams or Enterprise plan, your employer may have administrative visibility into your conversations. You may want to consider only using a personal Claude account for health conversations.

nodes.text: This Skill is meant to help you organize your experience and evaluate evidence. It should not be used to tell you what you have or what to do about it.
